text: The emergence of unconstrained mutual funds is driven by market forces: post-crisis structural and regulatory changes to the capital markets, a low interest rate environment, and the growth of private funds together created and then increased retail demand for alternative mutual funds.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: Structural and regulatory changes to the capital markets precipitated by the financial crisis of 2007–2008 and a low interest-rate environment, in combination with the enormous growth of private funds, created, and over time increased, the demand17 for retail "alternative" mutual funds.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: United States capital markets after the 2007 to 2008 financial crisis
